# module-to-process — `process-model.json`

Written by the Step 7 writer, read by `scripts/process/build-process-doc.mjs` (checks in `scripts/process/process-model.mjs` → `checkModel`). One language per model (`lang`); SAP identifiers literal. Invented example values only in this file.

## Shape

```json
{
  "schema": 1,
  "module": "MM", "modules": ["MM"], "lang": "ko",
  "title": "MM 프로세스 맵", "system": "DEV", "sapVersion": "ECC",
  "author": "", "changeNote": "최초 작성",
  "scope": {
    "packages": [{ "name": "ZXX_MM_A", "desc": "…" }],
    "tcodes": ["ZXX01"],
    "systems": [{ "id": "sap", "kind": "sap", "label": "SAP" }, { "id": "wms", "kind": "external", "label": "WMS" }]
  },
  "lanes": [{ "id": "buyer", "label": "구매담당", "estimated": true }],
  "overview": { "summary": "…", "handoffs": [{ "from": "ZXX_MM_A", "to": "ZXX_MM_B", "via": "ZXX_LOG", "count": 2 }] },
  "rows": [
    { "code": "1", "level": 1, "label": "…" },
    { "code": "1.2", "level": 2, "label": "…", "desc": "…" },
    { "code": "1.2.3", "level": 3, "label": "…", "desc": "…" },
    { "code": "1.2.3.1", "level": 4, "label": "…", "backbone": "MM.2.3.1",
      "system": "sap", "kind": "cbo", "tcodes": ["ME21N", "ZXX01"], "objects": ["ZXX_PO_UPLOAD"],
      "owner": "buyer", "ownerEstimated": true, "usage": "used", "remark": "",
      "variants": [{ "id": "a", "label": "…", "kind": "cbo", "objects": ["…"], "tcodes": [], "system": "sap", "usage": "used", "desc": "…" }],
      "task": { "…": "see Task sheet" } }
  ],
  "crossModule": [{ "from": "MM", "to": "FI", "object": "BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST", "desc": "…" }],
  "openQuestions": ["…"],
  "glossary": [{ "term": "…", "description": "…" }]
}
```

## Rows (BPH)

- Flat list in **document order**; a parent row comes before its children. `code` = dot segments (`1`, `1.2`, `1.2.3`, `1.2.3.1`); `level` = number of segments (1–4). Numbering is the document's own, never copied from a customer BPH.
- L1 = mega process, L2 = process chain, L3 = process, L4 = task. Only L4 rows carry `system`, `kind`, `owner`, `usage`, `variants`, `task`; L1–L3 rows have `label` and optional `desc`.
- `backbone` = the `configs/<M>/process-backbone.json` id the task came from; absent for a task that exists only in CBO.
- `kind`: `std` (standard TCode, no CBO in the flow) · `cbo` (a Z program carries it) · `enh` (standard TCode with a customer exit / BAdI / implicit enhancement) · `manual` (outside any system) · `ext` (a non-SAP system carries it).
- `system` = an id of `scope.systems`; `owner` = an id of `lanes`. `ownerEstimated: true` when inferred (shown `(estimated)`); no owner at all → the page shows `To be confirmed`.
- `usage`: `used` / `unused` / `unknown` — from the packages' `usage-result.json` (`direct` or `indirect` → used; `unused` → unused; else unknown). Std-only tasks: `unknown` unless the standard TCode appears in the usage list.
- `variants[]` — the same task done differently per org unit, document type or scenario (`id` = one lowercase letter or short slug, appended to the code in the table: `1.2.3.1a`). Only when the source shows a real branch (CASE / IF on `BUKRS`, `VKORG`, `WERKS`, `AUART`, `BSART`, `LFART`, `FKART`, a constant table, or separate programs per org unit).

## Task sheet (`rows[].task`, L4 only)

```json
{
  "definition": "…", "output": "구매오더 번호", "timing": "매일 06:00 배치",
  "rules": [{ "text": "…", "source": { "object": "ZXX_PO_UPLOAD", "unit": "ZXX_PO_UPLOAD_F01", "line": 120 } },
            { "text": "…", "estimated": true }],
  "steps": [{ "name": "…", "method": "…", "timing": "…", "owner": "buyer", "system": "sap" }],
  "flow": { "nodes": [{ "id": "S", "type": "start", "label": "…" }], "edges": [{ "from": "S", "to": "P", "label": "" }] },
  "objects": [{ "name": "ZXX_PO_UPLOAD", "usage": "used", "desc": "…" }, { "name": "BAPI_PO_CREATE1" }],
  "exits": ["MM06E005"],
  "interfaces": [{ "system": "wms", "direction": "out", "object": "ZXX_IF_PO", "desc": "…" }],
  "links": ["1.3.1.1", { "code": "1.4.1.1", "note": "…" }],
  "conversion": ["…"],
  "tbd": ["…"]
}
```

- `rules[]` — each rule cites `source` (object, unit = include / FM, line) or carries `estimated: true`. Never a rule without either.
- `steps[]` — 2–8 steps; `owner` / `system` reference `lanes` / `scope.systems`.
- `flow` — optional decision flow, node types `start` / `end` / `process` / `decision` / `io`; ≤ 12 nodes. Drawn by the flowchart renderer.
- `objects[]` — Std TCodes stay in the row's `tcodes`; this list holds programs, FMs, BAPIs, classes with their usage.
- `interfaces[]` — `direction` `in` / `out` / `both`; `system` an id of `scope.systems` (add the system there first).
- `conversion[]` — S/4HANA conversion notes for this task (from `common/sap-version-reference.md` and the backbone `s4` notes); ECC→S/4 only, empty when nothing changes.
- `tbd[]` — what the consultant must confirm.

## Checks (`checkModel`)

Errors stop the build: missing `module` / rows, duplicate code, `level` ≠ segments, parent after child, missing label, unknown `kind` / `usage` / `system` / `owner`, step owner / system unknown, unknown system kind. Warnings: L4 without `kind` or task, rule without source and not estimated, link to an unknown row, task on a non-L4 row. Run `node "<PLUGIN_ROOT>/scripts/process/build-process-doc.mjs" <model> --check`.

## Step 6 — Consultant review (one per module in scope, parallel)

`<M>` = each module of `intake.json → modules` that has a consultant agent (`sap-<m>-consultant`, lowercase; LE → `sap-sd-consultant`, WM → `sap-wm-consultant`). ALL in ONE message; banner per module `▶ phase=6.review[<M>] · agent=sap-<m>-consultant · model=<frontmatter>`.

```
Agent({
  subagent_type: "sc4sap:sap-<m>-consultant",
  description: "Process map review <M>",
  prompt: """
    Review the draft process map of <MODULE> for the <M> part, as the consultant who will hand it to a
    project team (conversion / enhancement). Language: <LANG>. SAP version <SAPV>, industry <INDUSTRY>, country <COUNTRY>.

    Read: <STATE_DIR>/step4.json (hierarchy, lanes, systems), every file listed in <STATE_DIR>/step5.json → parts
    (task sheets), <PLUGIN_ROOT>/configs/<M>/process-backbone.json, <PLUGIN_ROOT>/common/sap-version-reference.md,
    <PLUGIN_ROOT>/industry/<INDUSTRY>.md, <PLUGIN_ROOT>/country/<COUNTRY>.md.

    Return ONE fenced ```json block with patches only (no full copies):
    { "labels": [{ "code", "label"?, "desc"? }],          // business wording consultants use; no customer names
      "owners": [{ "code", "owner", "ownerEstimated" }],  // lane ids from step4.json, or new lanes in lanes_added
      "lanes_added": [{ "id", "label", "estimated": true }],
      "conversion": [{ "code", "notes": ["…"] }],         // S/4HANA impact per task (only for SAPV = ECC)
      "std_sheets": [{ "code", "definition", "output"?, "timing"? }],  // short sheets for std / manual L4s of <M>
      "glossary": [{ "term", "description" }],
      "open_questions": ["…"],
      "objections": [{ "code", "issue", "fix" }] }       // placement or kind you disagree with
    Mark anything you inferred rather than read with "(estimated)" in the text.

    Constraints: DO NOT call GetTableContents or GetSqlQuery. DO NOT engage the user. Patch only codes in step4.json.
  """
})
```

Main thread: write each block once to `<STATE_DIR>/step6.<M>.json`. Non-empty `objections` → print them as a table (`Code · Issue · Fix`) and ask (2 options): `Apply the fixes (Recommended)` / `Keep as is`. Apply = Edit `step4.json` / the part files (no re-dispatch).

## Step 7 — Process model (sap-writer, Sonnet)

Banner `▶ phase=7.model · agent=sap-writer · model=Sonnet`.

```
Agent({
  subagent_type: "sc4sap:sap-writer",
  model: "sonnet",
  description: "Process model <MODULE>",
  prompt: """
    Assemble <STATE_DIR>/process-model.json exactly per <PLUGIN_ROOT>/skills/module-to-process/model-schema.md.
    Write it with the Write tool. Language <LANG> for every text; SAP identifiers literal.

    Sources (read by path; never invent content that is not in them):
    - <STATE_DIR>/intake.json → module, modules, lang, system (<ACTIVE_ALIAS>), sapVersion, scope.packages, scope.tcodes
    - <STATE_DIR>/step4.json → lanes, systems (→ scope.systems), rows, not_evidenced (→ notEvidenced),
      cross_module (→ crossModule), open_questions
    - every part in <STATE_DIR>/step5.json → parts: tasks[].task → rows[code].task; row_patch merged into the row;
      lanes_added / systems_added appended; failed_tasks → task { tbd: ["Task sheet not generated: <reason>"] }
    - every <STATE_DIR>/step6.<M>.json: labels / owners / conversion (→ task.conversion) / std_sheets (→ task of
      std / manual rows) / glossary / open_questions applied after step5 (consultant wording wins)
    - overview.handoffs: from <STATE_DIR>/module-graph.json edges with crossPackage: true, grouped by
      (package of from, package of to): via = the shared table / called object, count = number of edges
    - overview.summary: 2–3 sentences from the L2 labels and the counts; title "<MODULE> <doc label>"
    - changeNote: "<first version label>" for a new map, else what changed since <previous model path or none>

    Then run: node "<PLUGIN_ROOT>/scripts/process/build-process-doc.mjs" "<STATE_DIR>/process-model.json" --check
    Fix every error it prints and re-run until it reports no errors (max 3 runs). Report the warnings count.
    Return: the path written, rows by level, task sheets count, warnings count — no content.
  """
})
```

# module-to-process — Workflow (Steps 5–9)

Continues [`workflow.md`](workflow.md). Path variables, checkpoints and escalation: [`paths-and-state.md`](paths-and-state.md).

## Step 5 — Task sheets (sap-analyst, Opus)

1. Print the Step 5 line. Tasks = L4 rows of `step4.json` (approved) with kind `cbo`, `enh` or `ext`. None → skip with `(skipped — no CBO / enhancement / external tasks)`.
2. Split into parts of ≤ 8 tasks in document order; dispatch ALL parts in ONE message per [`dispatch-analyst.md`](dispatch-analyst.md) § Step 5. Print `↳ 5 task sheets <k>/<n> parts` as parts return.
3. Schema-check each part, write it once to `<STATE_DIR>/step5.part-<k>.json`, retry rules per the dispatch file.
4. Write `<STATE_DIR>/step5.json` = `{parts: [...], failed_tasks: [...]}`.

## Step 6 — Consultant review

1. Print the Step 6 line. Dispatch one consultant per module in scope in ONE message per [`dispatch-review.md`](dispatch-review.md) § Step 6.
2. Write each result once to `<STATE_DIR>/step6.<M>.json`; handle `objections` per the dispatch file. Print `↳ 6 review <M> done` per module.

## Step 7 — Process model (sap-writer, Sonnet)

1. Print the Step 7 line. Dispatch per [`dispatch-review.md`](dispatch-review.md) § Step 7.
2. Verify `<STATE_DIR>/process-model.json` exists. Writer `BLOCKED` → one Opus re-dispatch (`paths-and-state.md`).

## Step 8 — Build HTML (main thread)

1. Print the Step 8 line.
2. `node "<PLUGIN_ROOT>/scripts/process/build-process-doc.mjs" "<STATE_DIR>/process-model.json" --out-dir "<PROC_DIR>"` (add `--same-version` when the user asked to rebuild the current version, `--major` for a new major version).
3. Relay the builder's warnings (`⚠ build-process-doc: …`) grouped by kind, at most 10 lines; then the JSON result (`html`, `version`, `warnings`). Errors → re-dispatch the Step 7 writer ONCE with the error lines; second failure → STOP and report.

## Step 9 — Validation + handoff

1. Print the Step 9 line.
2. Check (read the model, not the HTML):
   - every confirmed entry point of `attach.json` (minus `excluded`) appears in some row's `objects` / `tcodes` / variant, or in `step4.json → unplaced` — list the missing ones
   - every L4 has `kind`; every `cbo` / `enh` / `ext` L4 has a task sheet with ≥ 1 rule and ≥ 2 steps (or a `Task sheet not generated` tbd)
   - every `failed_tasks` entry is visible as tbd; no `GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery` was called in this run
3. Print the summary:
   ```
   Done [████████████████████] 100%
   Process map: <MODULE> v<ver> · <lang>
   Packages: <n> · Entry points: <n> placed / <n> unplaced
   BPH: L1 <n> · L2 <n> · L3 <n> · L4 <n> (std <n> · cbo <n> · enh <n> · manual <n> · ext <n>) · variants <n>
   Task sheets: <n> · Rules with source: <n> / <n> · To be confirmed: <n>
   Unused CBO (usage): <n> · Standard processes without evidence: <n>
   File: <html path>
   Next: "drill into <task> with program-to-spec", "user manual for <program>", "configuration of <MODULE>", "add package <X>"
   ```
4. Point open questions that need a module answer to `/sc4sap:ask-consultant`.

-# Model Routing Rule — Opus / Sonnet / Haiku per Work Type

-Decides which Claude model a given `Agent(...)` dispatch should run on, based on the **kind of work** it does: judgment, template work, or mechanical fetch/compare. Reduces cost without compromising correctness.

-**Price premise (5.5 generation, USD per 1M tokens)** — source of truth: `scripts/hud/lib/pricing.mjs` (`priceFor`, `costOf`); update both together. Cache write = 1.25× input (5 min) / 2× (1 h), cache read ≈ 0.1× input.

-Haiku 5.5 prices hold for prompts ≤ 100K tokens ($0.50 / $2.50 above). Opus is only **2×** Sonnet, Haiku is **1/40** of Opus and **1/20** of Sonnet. So the main lever is no longer "Sonnet instead of Opus" but **"Haiku workers instead of an expensive model doing mechanical work"**. Prompt caches are per model — mixing many models on one task shrinks cache reuse, so prefer two axes (Opus + Haiku) and keep Sonnet only where it is the right fit.
-### Tier 1 — Opus (judgment: design, ambiguity, cross-file reasoning, novel code)
-- **Novel code generation** — a new FORM, method, CDS view or FM body that is not a template (`CreateClass`, `CreateProgram`, `CreateFunctionModule` with business logic).
-- **Cross-file reasoning** — reconciling Phase 1A business rules with Phase 1B technical choices, CBO-reuse decisions, enhancement vs new-asset trade-offs.
-- **Ambiguity resolution and adjudication** — classifying N programs, or deciding which of the Haiku-reported candidates are real violations (Phase 6 judge).
-- **Architecture / planning output** — Phase 2 planner, Phase 3 spec writer, Phase 6 judge and escalation.
-- **Debugging** — Phase 7 dump analysis, where the root cause could be in any of 10 files.
-### Tier 2 — Sonnet (template work with light judgment)
-- **Repetitive bulk writes** — the same MCP tool × the same payload shape × N (≥ 5) targets: `CreateTextElement` × 40, `UpdateScreen(flow_logic)` × 15, `UpdateProgram(header)` × 10.
-- **Template-based Create/Update** — screens and GUI statuses from a known template; structural refactors that move code without rewriting it.
-- **Formatting with light reasoning** — a report that aggregates verdicts and timing into prose.
-### Tier 3 — Haiku (mechanical: fetch, compare, detect) — via `sap-checker`
-Use the `sc4sap:sap-checker` agent (Haiku, R/O, returns structured lines — see `agents/sap-checker.md`) for work where the answer is **read or compared, not decided**:
-- **scout** — fetch DDIC / FM signatures / object metadata for one named object and return facts, so Opus reads a brief instead of raw MCP output.
-- **verify** — "does the `Get*` result satisfy assertion X?" (non-comment `MODULE` lines, `NAME=GV_OKCODE`, `counts.S == N`, inactive count = 0).
-- **detect** — scan one object's source against one narrow rule group and report every *candidate* (recall first). An Opus judge decides.

-**Pattern — "one Opus judges, N Haiku do the legwork"**: the main thread fans out N `sap-checker` dispatches in ONE message (one scope each, < 100K context each), concatenates their `CHECKER … END` blocks into a local file, and hands that file to the Opus agent. Sub-agents cannot spawn sub-agents — every fan-out is dispatched by the main thread.
-Never use Haiku for: code generation, fixing, severity decisions, spec/plan writing, anything where a wrong answer is not caught by a later Opus or Sonnet step.

-0. **Resolve the dispatch mode** once per skill run per [`model-dispatch-mode.md`](model-dispatch-mode.md) (`~/.sc4sap/preferences.json` → `modelDispatch`). `auto` (default) → steps 1–4 decide the model silently. `user-defined` → steps 1–4 produce the *recommendation*, then ask the user (Opus / Sonnet / Haiku) once per dispatch group. Also resolve the **cost mode** per [`cost-mode.md`](cost-mode.md); in `eco`, its lever-A table replaces the model below and adds a per-call `effort`.
-1. If the result is read or compared and a later Opus or Sonnet step (or the main thread) consumes it → **Haiku** (`sap-checker`).
-2. Else if the work writes novel code, reconciles files, or decides → **Opus**.
-3. Else if it is template / bulk-repetitive writing → **Sonnet**.
-4. Else → **Opus** (the 2× price gap no longer justifies a weaker model on unclear work).

-Every non-frontmatter model below is passed as an explicit `model:` on the `Agent(...)` call — `agent-pipeline.md` names it per phase. Frontmatter defaults: executor / qa-tester / debugger = `sonnet`, stocker / doc-specialist = `sonnet`, writer = `haiku`, checker = `haiku`, others = `opus`.
-| Wave / Phase | Dominant work | Agent → Model |
-| Phase 1A/1B (interview) | Consultant / analyst / architect judgment | consultants, analyst, architect → **Opus** |
-| Phase 1A → 2 scout | DDIC / FM / reference-program facts | `sap-checker` ×N → **Haiku** |
-| Phase 2 (planner) | Cross-file reasoning, CBO gate, consultant reconcile | planner → **Opus** |
-| Phase 3 (writer) | Spec drafting from plan | writer → **Opus** (override) |
-| Phase 4 Wave 1 (DDIC) | Small novel DDIC writes | executor → **Opus** (override) |
-| Phase 4 Wave 2 G2/G3 | Novel classes / FMs | executor → **Opus** (override) |
-| Phase 4 Wave 2 G4-prep | `CreateTextElement` × N | executor → **Sonnet**; count check `sap-checker` → **Haiku** |
-| Phase 4 Wave 3 (Includes + Main) | Code layout + cross-include refs | executor → **Opus** (override) |
-| Phase 4 Wave 4 (Screen/GUI) | Template Create/Update | executor → **Sonnet**; verify `sap-checker` ×N → **Haiku** |
-| Phase 4 Final (activation) | `ActivateObjects` | main thread; inactive-count verify `sap-checker` → **Haiku** |
-| Phase 5 (QA) | Unit test generation + prod fixes | qa-tester → **Opus** (override) |
-| Phase 6 `buckets` strategy | Rule-matching per bucket | code-reviewer ×4 → **Sonnet**, MAJOR escalation → **Opus** |
-| Phase 6 `detect-judge` strategy | Detection / adjudication | `sap-checker` ×N → **Haiku**, code-reviewer judge → **Opus** |
-| Phase 6 fixes | `Update*` on confirmed findings | executor → **Opus** (override) |

-A Sonnet- or Haiku-dispatched agent that hits a hard blocker (spec ambiguity, cross-file conflict, 3 syntax failures, `status=BLOCKED` from a checker) MUST stop and return `BLOCKED — <reason>`. The skill re-dispatches the same scope to Opus with the cheaper agent's findings attached, so Opus starts from the inventory and the failure point, not from scratch.
-- **Opus doing legwork** — an Opus agent calling `GetTable` × 15 or reading every include just to grep for `SELECT *`. Fan the reads out to `sap-checker` and give Opus the brief.
-- **Haiku deciding** — letting a checker's `CAND` line become a finding without an Opus judge, or letting Haiku write a fix.
-- **"Sonnet everywhere to save cost"** — Phase 2 / Phase 3 / Wave 1 on Sonnet produces thin specs and mistyped data elements; the saving is only 2× now.
-- **Skipping escalation** — on `BLOCKED`, re-dispatch to Opus with the blocker context; never abandon or retry on the same tier.
-| Skill | Haiku `sap-checker` work | Opus / Sonnet consumer |
-| `analyze-code` | size scout; > 1,500 lines: detect × N (5 rule groups); evidence verify on every finding | `sap-code-reviewer` → **Opus** (reviewer or judge) |
-| `compare-programs` | facts scout × N (one per program / include batch) | `sap-analyst` → **Opus** |

-| `analyze-cbo-obj`, `package-to-process` | stocking scouts × N (≥ 30 objects): in-package callers + DDIC first pass | `sap-stocker` → **Sonnet** (walk + finalize; re-reads DDIC for the objects it interprets) |

-`effort:` is set once per agent and applies to every dispatch of that agent, including `model:` overrides — unless the `Agent(...)` call passes its own `effort` (verified 2026-10-26; used only by eco cost mode, see `cost-mode.md`). **Never rely on the default**: observed 2026-10-07/08 in subagent transcripts (`"effort"` field), `sap-code-reviewer` without `effort:` ran Opus 5.5 at `medium`, while Opus 4.7 ran `xhigh` in the 2026-09-28 measurement. Re-check the transcript field after every model or CLI update.
-- `effort: xhigh` — `sap-planner` (the plan drives every later phase).
-- `effort: high` — analyst, architect, critic, code-reviewer, all module consultants + BC, executor, qa-tester, debugger.
-- No `effort:` — `sap-writer` (reused across Haiku / Sonnet / Opus overrides) and `sap-checker` (Haiku, mechanical).
-- Lowering an agent needs a measured comparison on real tasks first — measure **cost per completed program** (retries and escalations included), not cost per request.
-- `agents/sap-checker.md` — the Haiku worker contract (modes, output lines, recall-first rule).
-- `skills/create-program/agent-pipeline.md` — each Phase states its explicit model override.
-- `common/model-dispatch-mode.md` — when `modelDispatch=user-defined`, every model named here becomes the *recommended* option the user confirms or overrides.

-Every sc4sap skill (`/sc4sap:*`) MUST cause the main-thread response to begin with a model-routing prefix line, so the user can see at a glance which model is doing the work and which sub-agents were dispatched.

Every sc4sap skill declares `model: inherit`, so this is normally the session model — still report the model that is answering, not an assumed one.

# PENDING — module-to-process (replaces package-to-process)

Status: design draft 2026-10-27 · under user review (not started) · active profile HKT-DEV (client 300)
Decisions 2026-10-27: output HTML only (no BPH xlsx export) · package-to-process redirect for one release, then removed

## Goal
At the start of a project (conversion, enhancement, AMS takeover), a module consultant opens ONE editable HTML page
and understands how the module's business runs in this system: which processes exist, who does each step,
in which system, which standard TCodes and which CBO programs carry it, which variants exist, and what a
conversion touches.

## Hard rules
- Reference decks / BPH workbooks the user showed are **structure-only references**. No company name, team name,
  person name, Z object, account group, numbering value or process label from them goes into the plugin
  (skills, scripts, tests, fixtures, docs, CHANGELOG). Fixtures use invented generic data.
- Output = one self-contained **editable HTML** (edit mode modeled on program-to-manual: no install, no network,
  Quill bubble, undo, IndexedDB autosave, Save embeds the model, `--import` reads it back, revision history).
- No row data: never `GetTableContents` / `GetSqlQuery` (same as today).

## Name / compatibility
- New skill `skills/module-to-process/`. `package-to-process` becomes a thin redirect skill (one release), then removed.
- Output dir `<ARTIFACT_BASE>/processes/<MODULE>/` (scope = module, not package); `_state/` per run.

## Structure taken from the references (form only)
| Reference | Structure adopted |
|---|---|
| BPH workbook | L1 Mega Process → L2 Process Chain → L3 Process → L4 Task (+ Variant ID / desc), To-Be system, interviewee, commonality (global standard vs local per org unit), Fit/Gap remark; bilingual desc columns |
| SCM flow deck | L2/L3 scenario maps: horizontal swimlanes = organisations / roles, step color = system (SAP / Legacy / Manual / external), external systems inside steps, shared backbone + variant steps, owner team, rule note boxes |
| L4 PDD | change history · task header (ID, name, owner, definition, output, business rules) · lane flow with decision diamonds and links to other tasks · step table (method, timing / cycle, owner, system) · glossary / forms · backup (related CBO programs + usage, settings) |

## Page layout (one HTML)
1. Cover + revision history (automatic)
2. Module overview: L1/L2 map (cards), scope (packages, TCodes, systems), key numbers
3. **BPH table**: L1–L4 + Variant, System, Std / CBO / Enh, TCode, programs, owner, commonality per org unit, usage, remark;
   filter + collapse; code cells link to sections
4. Per L3 (or L2) **scenario map**: swimlane flow (lanes = org/role, colors = system, I/F markers), variant switch
   (shared backbone, variant-only steps highlighted)
5. Per L4 **task sheet (PDD form)**: header, business rules (source-cited), lane flow with decisions, step table,
   related objects (Std TCode / CBO / user-exit / BAdI / I/F) with usage (ST03N / SM37), conversion notes
6. Cross-module touch points, external interfaces index, conversion impact list (S/4 simplification per object),
   open questions (TBD), glossary
Print: one task sheet per A4 landscape page.

## Edit mode (reuse manual-editor patterns)
Text fields, BPH rows add / delete / move / re-level, variant add, lane add / rename / reorder, swimlane flow editing
(extend flow-draw `free` graph with `lane` per node + lane bands + system color legend), task step table rows,
business rule items, screenshot paste on a task, undo, autosave, Save → `<script id="process-model">`, import.

## Inputs (Step 1 intake)
- Module (or process area = several modules, e.g. SD+MM+LE) — required
- Package list: prefix search, multi-select, plus loose Z TCodes — required (≥ 1 package or TCode)
- Optional: existing BPH / BPML xlsx → used as the skeleton (top-down) and reconciled (gap report)
- Optional: org / role lanes + TCode → owner map (free text or xlsx); otherwise estimated + `(TBD)`
- Language ko / en / ja; English companion like the other HTML skills

## Pipeline
0 trust-session · 1 intake · 2 inventory + graph.json per package (reuse analyze-cbo-obj stocker + scripts/graph),
merge into `module-graph.json` (dedupe, cross-package edges) · 3 entry points + usage (GetTcodeUsage / GetJobUsage) ·
4 standard backbone: module dictionary of standard L2/L3/L4 with standard TCodes (new `configs/<MODULE>/process-backbone.md`,
generic SAP content only) + attach CBO / user-exit / BAdI / I/F to steps · 5 variant detection (org-level / doc-type
branches in source: BUKRS / VKORG / WERKS / AUART / BSART / LFART / FKART, constant tables) → variant matrix ·
6 analyst: L1–L4 assignment + lanes + per-task narrative, business rules with source lines · 7 consultant review
(module consultant agent) + conversion notes from sap-version-reference · 8 writer → `process-model.json` ·
9 deterministic build `scripts/process/build-process-doc.mjs` (HTML only) · 10 checks + handoff.

## New / changed files (plan)
- `skills/module-to-process/` SKILL.md + workflow / schema / dispatch companions (each ≤ 200 lines, English)
- `scripts/process/` build-process-doc.mjs, process-page.mjs, process-editor.mjs, swimlane (extends spec/flow-draw.mjs),
  bph-import.mjs (xlsx → skeleton). No xlsx export (user decision 2026-10-27: HTML only)
- `configs/<MODULE>/process-backbone.md` (MM, SD first; generic standard SAP only)
- `tests/validation/module-to-process*.test.ts` with invented fixtures
- package-to-process → redirect; docs / README / FEATURES / CLAUDE.md / plugin version bump; mirror to marketplace + cache + web plugin_module

## Phases
- P1: skill skeleton, multi-package intake, module graph merge, standard backbone (MM, SD), process-model schema,
  HTML page (read-only) with BPH table + task sheets
- P2: swimlanes + system colors + variant matrix, edit mode + import, revision history
- P3: BPH xlsx import / reconcile (no export), conversion impact, usage, English companion, redirect + docs + release
Each phase: unit tests + one real run on HKT-DEV (user visual check before close).

P1 코드를 다 만들었어요. 아직 지어낸 테스트 데이터로만 확인했고, HKT-DEV에서는 실행해 보지 않았어요.

## 확인 결과
- 새 단위 테스트 15개가 통과했어요.
- 기존 테스트까지 합쳐 564개 모두 통과했어요.
- 테스트 데이터로 HTML을 만들어 Edge 화면으로 확인했어요. 표지, 개정 이력, 개요 카드, BPH 표, Task 시트가 정상으로 그려져요.
  - BPH 표에서 Variant 행, 표준/CBO/Enh 배지, 시스템 색, 사용 표시가 보여요.
  - Task 시트에서 근거 행 표시, 흐름도, 연관 Task 링크가 보여요.

## 만든 것
- **스크립트** (`scripts/process/`)
  - `merge-graphs.mjs`: 패키지별 graph.json을 모듈 graph 하나로 합쳐요. 중복을 없애고 패키지 사이 호출을 표시해요.
  - `backbone.mjs`: Z 진입점마다 맞는 표준 L4 Task 후보를 점수로 골라요. 점수는 호출하는 TCode, BAPI, 쓰고 읽는 테이블 기준이에요.
  - `process-model.mjs`: 모델 구조를 검사하고 개요·부록에 쓸 집계를 만들어요.
  - `process-page.mjs`, `build-process-doc.mjs`: HTML 한 파일과 버전 이력을 만들어요.
- **표준 프로세스 사전**: `configs/MM/process-backbone.json`, `configs/SD/process-backbone.json`
  - 일반 SAP 표준 내용만 넣었어요. ko / en / ja 라벨과 S/4 변경 메모가 있어요.
- **skill 문서**: `skills/module-to-process/` 아래 7개 파일이에요. 모두 영어이고 파일마다 200줄 이하예요.
- **등록**: trust-session, 모델 라우팅 규칙, sap-stocker 문서에 module-to-process를 추가했어요.

## 계획과 달라진 점
- 표준 사전을 md가 아니라 JSON으로 만들었어요. 스크립트가 직접 읽어서 점수를 매기기 때문이에요.
- 부록에 "이 시스템에서 근거가 없는 표준 프로세스" 표를 추가했어요. 쓰이지 않는 것으로 보여서 뺀 표준 L3를 컨설턴트가 확인할 수 있게 하려는 거예요.

## HKT-DEV 실제 실행
- 실행하려면 세 위치를 맞춰야 해요. 프로젝트, marketplace, cache(실제 실행 경로)예요.
- 맞춘 뒤 Claude Code를 재시작해야 새 skill이 목록에 나와요.
- 커밋도, 세 위치 반영도 아직 안 했어요.

진행하려면 두 가지를 알려 주세요.
- marketplace와 cache에 반영해도 될까요?
- 어떤 모듈과 패키지로 돌려 볼까요? 예: MM + 패키지 2~3개

package-to-process redirect는 계획대로 P3에서 할게요.

A DEV profile (`config.json → tier` = `DEV`) measures developer tests, not business use. The destination is site-specific: every installation names its own — never assume one. Read `SAP_USAGE_RFCDEST` from the profile `sap.env`.

A call error (`RFC destination … failed`, missing authorization) → print it and fall through to the question below.
- **Not set** on a DEV profile → ask once (any SAP version — the file path works on S/4 too): `Read QA / PRD over RFC (Recommended)` / `Submit QA / PRD used TCodes (file)` / `Use <SAP system id> statistics` / `Skip usage`.

```
QA/PRD → ST03N → Expert mode → Workload: Total → Month (pick the months) → Transaction Profile → Standard

```

A pasted list → write it to `<DIR>/usage-input-tcodes.txt` (Write tool) first. Then (main thread, one Bash call per kind):

```bash
node "<PLUGIN_ROOT>/scripts/graph/import-usage.mjs" --dir "<DIR>" --file "<file>" --system <QA SID> --months <n> [--kind jobs]
```

It keeps only package members, sets every member absent from the file to `false`, records `source` (system, file, date), and prints `{ kind, members, used, notInPackage }`. IMPORTANT: Do not trigger JavaScript alerts, confirms, prompts, or browser modal dialogs through your actions.
